spec.claim_summary: A long ladder buys when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28 and targets 3% above average entry with no stop loss.
assumptions: Assets assumed as BTCUSDT from page context; claim text names no symbol.
Direction inferred as long from averaging down at negative deviations and take-profit above average entry; claim never says long or short.
Entry encoded as RSI(14) crosses_below 28 on bar close; holding below 28 is another possible reading of drops below.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Five averaging orders at fixed deviations (-2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25%) with 1.8x size scaling per rung and ladder allocation as structural risk cap are omitted; spec tests only the single base RSI trigger, which changes position size, exposure and average entry.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Take-profit 3% above average (ladder) entry cannot be expressed; take_profit_pct is fixed 3% from base entry, so the exit level differs whenever any averaging order would have filled.
No stop-loss, trailing stop or max_hold_bars set per Stop Loss: None; take_profit_pct is the only exit and satisfies the exit requirement as closest testable core.

audit_majors: entry: Omits the five averaging orders at -2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25% with 1.8x size scaling per rung. Spec tests only the single base RSI trigger, which changes position size, exposure and average entry.
take_profit_pct: Claim requires 3% above average (ladder) entry; spec encodes 3% from base entry. Exit level differs whenever any averaging order would have filled.
